description: Source code for VCNL4040 sensor trigger handling in Zephyr OS, including interrupt handling, trigger configuration, and thread management.

methods.name: vcnl4040_handle_cb
methods.description: Handles callback for VCNL4040 interrupt, disables GPIO interrupt and signals thread or work queue.

methods.name: vcnl4040_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback function that processes GPIO interrupt and calls handle callback.

methods.name: vcnl4040_handle_int
methods.description: Main interrupt handler that reads interrupt source and delegates to specific handlers.

methods.name: vcnl4040_thread_main
methods.description: Thread main function for handling triggers in own thread.

methods.name: vcnl4040_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for global thread trigger processing.

methods.name: vcnl4040_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as thresholds.

methods.name: vcnl4040_trigger_init
methods.description: Initializes trigger mechanism, GPIO, and thread or work queue.
